say:1:1241134001:1.text: What's inside the experimental notes of the Dead Tide Fleet is downright horrifying...
say:1:1241134001:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队留下了很多实验记录，简直是骇人听闻……

say:2:1241134002:1.text: Marine life, land creatures, birds, and even humans... None escape their clutches!
say:2:1241134002:1.source_cn: 不管是海洋生物、陆地动物，还是鸟类，甚至是人……他们全...

say:3:1241134003:1.text: I even came across reports on rodent experiments... It was utterly appalling!
say:3:1241134003:1.source_cn: 我还看到了啮齿类动物的实验报告……真是太可怕了！！
